result.summary: Fixes or removes several stale, undefined, or mismatched C++ function declarations across RPC, common, Qt, and HTTP headers. Functions that were defined locally without matching public declarations are either marked static or have their header declarations corrected.
result.problem: Unused and mismatched function declarations clutter headers and prevent the build system from cleanly enabling compiler warnings such as -Wmissing-declarations and -Wmissing-prototypes.
evidence: PR description: 'Split out of #36743. Ideally we can have the compiler enforce/flag this in future.'
result.scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup touching five different subsystems (RPC, Qt, HTTP, common).
result.card: Cleans up several stale, undefined, or mismatched function declarations across RPC, Qt, HTTP, and common headers. Removing or correcting these declarations resolves dead prototypes and prevents declaration mismatches with definitions. It is split out of PR 36743 to pave the way for enabling compiler flags like -Wmissing-declarations.

risk.why: A mistake in header declarations could cause compilation or linking errors, which CI would immediately catch.
